provides: Currencies and exchange rates: a Currency catalog keyed by ISO 4217 code with Decimal rates relative to a configurable base currency, cross-rate conversion (convert()) exposed as a comm Function, a pluggable rate-provider seam (ECB by default), a public read-only HTTP API, and a Celery task / management commands to refresh rates.

curated.summary: ISO 4217 code every Currency.value rate is relative to. The base currency always converts at rate 1. Changing it reinterprets stored rates — re-run update_exchange_rates after switching (conf.py, MODULE.md Extension points table).
Decimal places conversion results are quantized to (ROUND_HALF_UP) in services.convert and the currencies.convert Function (conf.py, MODULE.md).

extension_points.name: RATE_PROVIDER
extension_points.summary: REPLACE, single strategy: implement the RateProvider ABC (providers.py) and point the setting at it — default ECBRateProvider (ECB eurofxref-daily.xml, rebased when base != EUR); enforced as a RateProvider subclass by get_rate_provider() (conf.py, MODULE.md 'Rate providers').

extension_points.name: DEFAULT_CURRENCIES
extension_points.summary: Seed list read by the load_default_currencies management command (code/display_name/symbol/value dicts); replaces the default 16-currency list wholesale (conf.py, MODULE.md).

surface.name: convert
surface.intent: Convert a Decimal amount between two active currencies via the base-currency cross rate, quantized to CONVERSION_DECIMAL_PLACES (ROUND_HALF_UP). Call this instead of reading Currency.value rows and dividing/multiplying by hand — the base-currency short-circuit, the active-currency check and the rounding rule are each an easy place to drift from the framework's answer.
instead_of: Currency.value ratio computed and rounded by hand

surface.name: get_rate_provider
surface.intent: Instantiate the configured STAPEL_CURRENCIES['RATE_PROVIDER'] (validated as a RateProvider subclass). Reach for this instead of resolving/import_string-ing the setting yourself whenever you need today's rates without persisting them — e.g. a preview endpoint that shows what update_exchange_rates would change.

surface.name: update_exchange_rates
surface.intent: Fetch rates from the configured RATE_PROVIDER and update the Currency rows in one call — the same seam the Celery task and the update_exchange_rates management command already use. Call it from your own scheduler or admin action instead of re-implementing the fetch-then-save loop.

requires.reason: AppSettings config layer, comm Function (currencies.convert), error registry — the only stapel-* dependency (pyproject.toml: 'Depends on stapel-core only'; conf.py:11, functions.py:19, errors.py:6)
